title: 第13章 登上缥缈天梯之前将他永远留下第14章 我已给你活命的机会是你自己不珍惜
lines: 几天之后，他会出现在缥缈宗……”
黑衣男子语速平缓，正视绝刃剑子良星尘的锋芒。
良星尘目光微抬，淡淡的说道：“那个人是缥缈宗的新人？”
对方道：“你可以在他成为新人前完成这件事情。”
良星尘眼角一凝，似乎在思索着什么。
黑衣男子则是继续道：“不必怀疑我别有所图，为了以示诚意，明日天亮之前，天罡剑宗的所有人都会退出沙城境内，到时候你可以令人筑起防御边城，彻底的把沙城掌控住……”
良星尘饶有兴致的问道：“我很好奇，究竟是什么样的人，竟然肯让剑宗的少宗主用沙城去换他的性命。”
“一只低贱的蝼蚁罢了！”
良星尘俊眉轻挑：“蝼蚁的命这么值钱？”
“并不是他的命值钱，而是天罡剑宗的威严值钱，此人触犯了剑宗的门威，所以他该死……”
黑衣男子身上散发着冷冽的气息，他眸中闪动着幽光：“还有一个要求，到时候希望绝刃剑子派人把他的项上人头送到晰月城萧家……”
无形的气流暴涌，沙城的上空，悄然间黄尘弥漫。
片刻之后……
余亢，林玉回到了良星尘身边的时候，城台上只有对方一人。
“星尘师兄，天罡剑宗的人并未发起突袭。”
余亢说道。
林玉也跟着开口：“其他地方也都平静。”
“那家伙呢？”
余亢问道。
良星尘眼角冷逸，溢出一缕傲然的笑意：“走了……”
“走了？”
两人对视一眼。
良星尘转身看向二人：“明日一早通知宗门，沙城已经拿下。”
什么？
余亢，林玉更是一脸错愕。
数天后。
离开了晰月城，在云城短暂停留的萧诺顺利的抵达了缥缈宗境内。
今日正好是缥缈宗招收新人的时期，在那缥缈宗的山门之外，早已是聚集了各路的年轻天才。
萧诺跟随着众人一路上山，很快就便抵达了一座古老的峰顶云台。
站在云台上，眺望着缥缈宗仙门，远远的望去，其座落于群山之间，矗立于仙雾之中，给人的感觉宛如凡尘仙宫。
“真是壮观啊！
缥缈宗感觉就跟人间仙境。”
有人惊叹道。
“你不废话吗？东荒七大修行圣地之一，世间梦寐以求的地方。”
“今天来了好多人啊！”
“嗯，有两三百人。”
好两三百个新人弟子，真要说起来，并不算多。
但事实上，缥缈宗招收新人的方式有所不同，需要有人举荐，才能获取进入宗门的资格。
而且进入宗门后，如若表现平庸，一直以来都没什么长进的话，还会面临被驱逐的风险。
所以今天能够出现在这峰台上的，或多或少都有些背景。
content_en:
In a few days, he will appear in Piao Miao Sect..."
The man in black spoke slowly, looking squarely at the edge of the ultimate sword Ziliang Xingchen.
Liang Xingchen raised his eyes slightly and said calmly: "Is that person a newcomer to the Piaomiao Sect? "
The other party said: “You can complete this matter before he becomes a new person. "
Liang Xingchen's eyes narrowed, as if he was thinking about something.
The man in black continued: "Don't doubt that I have ulterior motives. To show my sincerity, everyone in the Tiangang Sword Sect will withdraw from Shacheng before dawn tomorrow. At that time, you can build a defensive border city and completely control Shacheng..."
Liang Xingchen asked with great interest: "I am very curious about what kind of person he is, who is willing to let the young master of the Sword Sect trade the sand city for his life. "
"Just a lowly ant! "
"oh? "
Liang Xingchen raised his handsome eyebrows lightly: "Is the life of an ant so valuable? "
"It's not that his life is valuable, but the majesty of the Tiangang Sword Sect is valuable. This person has violated the prestige of the Sword Sect, so he deserves to die..."
The man in black exuded a cold aura, and there was a glint in his eyes: "There is one more request. I hope Juebian Jianzi will send someone to deliver his head to the Xiao family in Xiyue City..."
"Wow! "
Invisible air surges, and yellow dust quietly fills the sky above the sand city.
After a while...
When Yu Kang and Lin Yu returned to Liang Xingchen, he was the only one on the city platform.
“Senior Brother Xingchen, the people from the Tiangang Sword Sect did not launch a surprise attack. "
Yu Kang said.
Lin Yu also spoke: "Other places are also calm. "
"Where's that guy? "
Yu Kang asked.
Liang Xingchen's eyes were cold, and a proud smile overflowed: "Let's go..."
"Leaving? "
The two looked at each other.
Liang Xingchen turned to look at the two of them: "Notify the sect early tomorrow morning that Shacheng has been captured. "
What?
Yu Kang and Lin Yu were even more stunned.
…
A few days later.
After leaving Xiyue City, Xiao Nuo, who stayed briefly in Yuncheng, successfully arrived at the Piaomiao Sect.
Today happened to be the time for the Piaomiao Sect to recruit new people. Outside the mountain gate of the Piaomiao Sect, young geniuses from all walks of life had already gathered.
Xiao Nuo followed everyone up the mountain and soon arrived at an ancient peak cloud platform.
Standing on the cloud platform, looking at the Immortal Gate of Piaomiao Sect, looking from a distance, it is located between the mountains, standing in the fairy mist, giving people the feeling of an mundane fairy palace.
“What a spectacle!
Piaomiao Sect feels like a fairyland on earth. "
someone exclaimed.
"Don't you talk nonsense? One of the seven holy places of cultivation in the Eastern Wasteland, a place that is coveted in the world. "
"There are so many people here today! "
“Well, there were two to three hundred people. "
"..."
There are two to three hundred new disciples, which is not too many to be honest.
But in fact, the Piaomiao Sect recruits new members in a different way. Someone needs to recommend them before they can be qualified to enter the sect.
Moreover, after entering the sect, if your performance is mediocre and there has been no progress, you will still face the risk of being expelled.
So those who can appear on this peak today have more or less backgrounds.
